# Symbolic System

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SymbolicSystem>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A system of symbols, signs, or conventions used for communication, representation, or expression. Broad umbrella covering notation systems, gesture systems, emoji conventions, platform conventions, and other non-linguistic symbol systems. NOT a language by default; a standpointed claim may classify a symbolic system as a language ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

Use [`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the broad umbrella for any convention-bearing symbol system that is not itself a language — gesture systems, emoji conventions, platform conventions, and the parent domain when a fact ranges over symbol systems generally rather than the narrower structured-notation subkind.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a natural or formal language (use [`gmeow:Language`](gmeow-Language.md) / [`gmeow:FormalLanguage`](gmeow-FormalLanguage.md)) and avoid asserting bare [`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md) when the structured [`gmeow:NotationSystem`](gmeow-NotationSystem.md) subkind applies; never silently treat the system as a language — that is a standpointed claim, not a default.

### How to use

- Type the system as [`SymbolicSystem`](gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md) (or the [`NotationSystem`](gmeow-NotationSystem.md) subkind), tag its domain with [`gmeow:symbolicSystemKind`](../properties/gmeow-symbolicSystemKind.md), and route any language-classification through the standpoint layer rather than asserting it globally.

### Examples

- ex:morse a [`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md); [`gmeow:symbolicSystemKind`](../properties/gmeow-symbolicSystemKind.md) [`gmeow:symbolicKindEncoding`](../individuals/gmeow-symbolicKindEncoding.md).
